links.outcome: Model discrimination (AUC) on local historical data in Danish populations versus PLCOm2012
links.effect: LungFlag outperformed PLCOm2012 in Population A (AUC: 0.63 vs. 0.60) and showed slightly higher sensitivity in Population B, though differences were minor.

screen.reason: Retrospective external validation of an existing machine learning risk-prediction model (LungFlag) compared with PLCOm2012 in two Danish patient cohorts; tests accuracy/discrimination without evaluating a deployment safeguard or practice.
